x: A fine win here by one second for Martin Gillings from brother Ian. Former RAF 3-miles champion Bill Merryman must be proud of his nephews.
Our very young team of Colts did excellently, gaining third team medals, Ian Gillings being placed second in 14m. 54s., some 32s. behind the winner, A.

The day before the race our team, Bob Glover and Charlie Manning, flushed with success from their recent 5,000 metre Club Championship, were out from their training camp and did two laps of the course with Ted Stimpson, Ian and Martin Gillings.
Nice to see Ian and Martin Gillings in action again, we hear they have been doing some great running at school. If we were to give a medal for perseverance it would have to go to Ivan Beaumont.
